name: hipfire-perf-profiling
description: Profile hipfire performance on AMD systems before choosing a tuning lever. Covers memory-bandwidth math, rocprofv3 CSV and rocpd kernel traces, AMDuProfCLI/Pcm/Sys platform telemetry, amd-smi/rocm-smi clocks and power, benchmark hygiene, and handoff to kernel tuning or Kernel Atlas.
